step_title: Identify the contract with a customer.
step_detail: A contract establishes the legal rights and obligations of both the seller and customer.

step_title: Identify the performance obligation(s) in the contract.
step_detail: The contract may have one or more performance obligations (e.g. hardware + software).
The transaction price is the amount the seller is entitled to receive from the customer.

step_title: Allocate the transaction price to each performance obligation.
step_detail: If multiple obligations exist the contract price must be split proportionally among them.

step_title: Recognize revenue when (or as) each performance obligation is satisfied.
step_detail: Revenue is recognized at a point in time or over time depending on how the obligation is satisfied.
